references.text: God commands Israel to take possession of the Amorites' land, which is fulfilled in Num 21:31
Moses reminds the people how they took the Amorites' land and settled there
Joshua recounts how Israel came to the Amorites' land and took it as their own
The kingdom of the Amorite king Sihon is given to the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh
Reference to the victory over the Amorite king Sihon and how Israel took his land
Jephthah refers to how Israel took the Amorites' land and settled in all their cities
